topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: R2 live walk 2026-05-19T23:46Z: umbrella dept-30 = 2384 unique products (matches 'found' text). 7-subclass union = 2372 unique. Umbrella-only = 12 (archery/crossbow/CZ-magazine/freight items not classified into the 7 main subclasses). Subclass-only = 0. Subclass sum 676+447+723+252+114+100+60 = 2372. 2372 + 12 umbrella-only = 2384. The 12 orphan SKUs prove the 7-subclass DB catalogUrl set UNDER-covers by 0.5%; umbrella is strictly superset and the correct choice per Rule A (100% coverage) and Rule C (min URL count).

auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected; restock alerts required (Inet exposes no batch REST/JSON API)
auditNotes.platformNotes: Activant/Epicor iNet eCommerce. Apache+PHP, /inet/storefront/store.php backend, PHPSESSID+INET_MOBILE session cookies. URL form: /departments/<slug>-|<deptId>|<subclass>.html. Pipe character `|` is non-reserved per RFC3986 and both literal `|` and `%7C` return identical 200 responses (verified R2). Node `new URL()` preserves both forms through round-trip without re-encoding (verified R2). DB-historical 'must be literal' note is unfounded — the runtime concat path `${origin}${u}` plus axios both transmit the literal pipe verbatim. Pagination via ?top=<offset>. Product URL form: /products/<slug>|<SKU-or-id>.html.
auditNotes.paginationWalkProof: R2 walked all 10 pages of umbrella URL (top=0..2295, step 255) -> 2384 unique product URLs. Exact match with displayed 'N found' text. Walked all 7 subclasses page-by-page -> totals match their respective 'found' counts (676+447+723+252+114+100+60 = 2372).
auditNotes.searchUrlNotes: DB-historical `/search?q={keyword}` returns 404 (verified R2: GET /search?q=glock -> 404). Live search form on homepage submits GET to `/inet/storefront/store.php?mode=searchstore&search[searchfor]={keyword}` (verified R2: GET .../mode=searchstore&search[searchfor]=glock -> 200, '24 found, showing page 1 of 2', 24 glock-related product URLs in DOM). This is the authoritative search endpoint.
auditNotes.countMethodNotes: R1's `regex: 'of\\s+(\\d+)' + perPage: 255` extracted '10' (totalPages) and computed 10x255=2550, overshooting true 2384 by 6.96% (exceeds 5% drift gate). R2 corrected to `regex: '([\\d,]+)\\s+found' + perPage: 1`. NOTE: the runtime html-pagination case at product-count-probe.ts:222-241 does `parseInt(matched[1])` which truncates '2,384' to 2; the consumer must strip commas before parseInt for this method to work on comma-formatted totals. Flagged to R3/R4 as a small runtime patch.
